description_en: Verifies the HMAC message authentication code of a specific message by using a specified key
description_zh: 使用指定密钥校验特定消息的HMAC消息认证码
name: VerifyMac

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the key. You can also specify the alias or Alibaba Cloud Resource Name (ARN) of the key. For more information about aliases, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/480655.html.
To access a key that belongs to another Alibaba Cloud account, you must enter the ARN of the key. The ARN of a key is in the `acs:kms:${region}:${account}:key/${keyid}` format
parameters.help_zh:
密钥的ID，也可以指定为密钥别名或密钥资源名称（ARN）。关于别名的详细介绍，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/480655.html。
访问其他阿里云账号下的密钥时，必须输入密钥ARN。密钥ARN的格式为`acs:kms:${region}:${account}:key/${keyid}`
parameters.name: key_id

parameters.help_en: The Base64 encoding of the message authentication code to be authenticated
parameters.help_zh: base64编码的待校验消息验证码
parameters.name: mac

parameters.help_en:
The original message data.  

The data must be Base64-encoded. For example, if the hexadecimal content of the message for which you want to generate a message authentication code is `[0x31, 0x32, 0x33, 0x34]`, the corresponding Base64-encoded string is `MTIzNA==`
parameters.help_zh:
原始消息数据。  

使用Base64编码。例如：待生成消息验证码的十六进制内容为`[0x31, 0x32, 0x33, 0x34]`，则对应的Base64编码为`MTIzNA==`
parameters.name: message

parameters.help_en:
The algorithm used to generate the message authentication code. Valid values vary based on the key specification:  

HMAC_SM3

HMAC_SHA_224

HMAC_SHA_256

HMAC_SHA_384

HMAC_SHA_512
parameters.help_zh:
生成消息验证码的算法。依据使用的密钥规格不同，可取值包括：  

HMAC_SM3

HMAC_SHA_224

HMAC_SHA_256

HMAC_SHA_384

HMAC_SHA_512
parameters.name: algorithm

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable the dry run mode. Valid values:
true: enables the dry run mode.
false: disables the dry run mode. This is the default value.

The dry run mode is used to test API calls, verify whether you have the required permissions on the resources, and check whether the request parameters are correctly configured. When the dry run mode is enabled, KMS always returns a failure and provides the cause of the failure. The causes include:
DryRunOperationError: The request would succeed if the DryRun parameter is not configured.
ValidationError: A specified parameter in the request is invalid.
AccessDeniedError: You do not have permissions to perform this operation on the KMS resource
parameters.help_zh: 是否开启DryRun模式。true：开启false（默认值）：关闭DryRun模式用于测试API调用，验证您是否具有相应资源的权限，以及请求参数是否配置正确。DryRun模式开启后，KMS会始终返回失败并提示失败原因。失败原因包含如下：DryRunOperationError：不配置DryRun参数时，请求会成功。ValidationError：请求中指定的参数有误。AccessDeniedError：您无权在KMS资源上执行该操作
parameters.name: dry_run

HMAC_SHA_256

HMAC_SHA_384

KeyId.description_en:
The globally unique identifier of the master key.

If the KeyId parameter in the request is set to the alias of the master key, the response returns the identifier of the master key to which the alias points
KeyId.description_zh:
主密钥的全局唯一标识符。

如果请求中的KeyId参数使用的是主密钥的别名，在响应中会返回别名对应的主密钥标识符

RequestId.description_en: The ID of the request. The ID is a unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request and can be used for troubleshooting
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题

Value.description_en: Indicates whether the message authentication code is successfully verified
Value.description_zh: 消息认证码校验是否成功
